company.name: Cuboh
company.shortDescription: Cuboh is a developer of an application intended to automate online food orders for restaurants.
company.description: Cuboh is a developer of an application intended to automate online food orders for restaurants. The company's platform helps to use several delivery platforms like Doordash, Postmates, UberEats and more by bringing them all to one system and integrating it with POS systems, enabling restaurants to manage all online orders on just one easy-to-use interface, easily add new apps and expand to new markets.

productsAndServices.description: A system that consolidates orders from multiple third-party delivery apps into a single tablet interface for easier management.
productsAndServices.name: Tablet Consolidation

productsAndServices.description: Integration of third-party delivery app orders directly with a restaurant's Point of Sale system to reduce errors and improve order accuracy.
productsAndServices.name: POS Integrations

productsAndServices.description: A centralized platform to manage and update menus across multiple third-party delivery apps simultaneously.
productsAndServices.name: Menu Management

productsAndServices.description: A commission-free online ordering system that enables restaurants to accept orders directly from customers without relying on third-party delivery apps.
productsAndServices.name: Direct Online Ordering System

productsAndServices.description: Customer service providing timely assistance and support for Cuboh users, available daily with rapid response times.
productsAndServices.name: Customer Support

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $40,000, or 2.8% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $33,937, representing 2.38% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,251,414 to $7,633,531, a 2.35x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 17 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 44 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Menu.ca, Deliverect, Chowly.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
